title: An overview of new design concepts for green aviation
author: Joăo Marcos de Morais Silva
abstract: The aviation industry is a significant contributor to global greenhouse gas emissions, prompting the need for sustainable solutions. This report conducts an overview of the innovative design concepts on green aviation aimed at achieving net zero carbon emissions by 2050. The research focuses on emerging technologies such as Sustainable Aviation Fuels (SAF), hydrogen propulsion, and electric aircrafts. Key industry concepts and solutions are analyzed for their contributions to sustainable aviation, the challenges associated with each technology and the overall technology maturity level for each novel concept. The findings highlight the critical role of international collaborations and policy frameworks in driving technology development towards sustainability. This work underscores the importance of continued research and development, investing in promissing technologies and global cooperation to meet the goal of zero carbon emissions by mid-century.
